name: Bebê
prompt: Create ONE ORIGINAL BABY Soulmonsters LAND SNAIL plus CAR TIRE, pre-evolution of supplied own adult wind-wheel snail. Tiny simple compact living PAPER INNER-TUBE CREATURE centered on WHITE with generous margins. ONE small soft rounded CHARCOAL NAVY RUBBER-RING SHELL folded as a single uncomplicated coil, almost like a small rolled paper donut, ONE acid lime stripe and just TWO shallow wide tread notches. A little GOLDEN OCHRE snail head emerges directly from lower-front opening, short soft cream foot pad under ring, no long neck or full adult body. Exactly TWO short upper eye stalks with small gentle amber eyes at tips and TWO very tiny lower feeler buds beside simple little smiling mouth; no extra eyes on face, no mammal nose/ears/arms/legs. No metal wheel rim. Center of coil is one small ivory tensioned paper patch held by ONE short curved warm bamboo rib and ONE PURPLE knot, no intricate spokes or many panels. ONE short purple soul cord from rear lower ring knot with ONE small lime/ivory paper pennant. Quiet innocent expression, two small curved brow caps not adult angry helmet, very few large shapes, no wings yet. Family palette warm ochre body, ivory underfoot/paper, charcoal navy ring, acid lime accent, purple knots. Clean confident 2D MANGA ink, flat colors and ONE simple hard cel shadow, no gradients/shiny rubber/realistic slime/noisy tread details/crumpled paper/text/logos/scenery. This is a baby living-kite gastropod with tire shell, not a baby face drawn on wheel, not a robot or normal snail with unrelated toy tire.
story: Aprende a aderir e se recolher numa pequena concha de borracha-papel.
review: Um pé curto, concha única, dois olhos nos tentáculos superiores e dois tentáculos menores. Dois terminais aparentes na rabiola, apesar de um previsto. Torso resultou mais completo que a proposta de cabeça diretamente no aro.

name: Criança
prompt: Create ONE ORIGINAL CHILD Soulmonsters LAND SNAIL + CAR TIRE living kite, intermediate between supplied own simple baby and supplied adult wheel-sentinel. Full complete three-quarter creature on WHITE, generous margins. Clearly GROWING SNAIL: one longer flexible GOLDEN OCHRE body with CREAM underside, ONE broad muscular FOOT stretched flat in front and behind like a short PAPER SLED, three broad folded edge lobes along foot and a pointed front braking lip. No arms or legs. Head at front raised only slightly, TWO moderately long upper EYESTALKS with small curious amber eyes under dark navy rounded brow caps, TWO short lower feelers beside small confident mouth, NO additional eyes on face. Head smaller relative body than baby. ONE thick charcoal navy TIRE-SHELL sits obliquely on back with just FOUR large lime CHEVRON TREAD patches, smooth no realistic rubber detail. Shell SIDE is an IVORY coiled PAPER SPIRAL braced by TWO curved warm bamboo ribs meeting at one purple knot off-center; this is the natural living shell, not a separate toy wheel or metal wheel rim. Exactly TWO short black/lime triangular PAPER TABS fold against upper shell sides, beginning future wind panels, do not open as giant wings yet. One tiny purple rim knot tethers a short rear soul-rabiola cord with TWO small lime/ivory kite pennants. Body alert and lively learning traction, not adult towering long neck or baby blob. Family palette warm ochre, ivory, charcoal/navy, acid lime, purple binding knots. Broad smooth shapes, crisp original 2D MANGA ink and ONE flat base + ONE HARD CEL SHADOW per material. No mechanical car parts, engine, exhaust, translucent slime, glossy tire, gradients, texture, intricate tread, noisy paper folds, motion lines, text, logos or scenery. Distinct one shell, one continuous muscular foot, four tentacles total.
story: Alonga o pé de apoio e desenvolve sulcos largos e abas ainda fechadas na concha.
review: Uma concha-pneu, um pé contínuo, quatro tentáculos, sem braços ou pernas. Dois terminais de rabiola com fio proximal curto. Laterais da concha com espiral e três varetas, em vez das duas previstas. Silhueta ainda próxima do adulto, diferenciada pelas abas pequenas, pescoço e rosto infantis.

name: Jovem
prompt: Create ONE ORIGINAL YOUNG adolescent Soulmonsters SNAIL plus CAR TIRE living kite, based on supplied own child and adult concepts. Major structural difference: a LOW WIDE BANKING posture, the ONE tire-shell TILTED ALMOST HORIZONTALLY on the back, its round side facing upward at a slant like a compressed coiled canopy, NOT the upright tall wheel of child or adult. Long broad GOLDEN OCHRE muscular foot is a LOW ARROWHEAD PAPER SKID with ivory underside and three broad folded ridges, front lip sweeps forward and lower, back foot small. No separate arms or legs. Head and neck extend FORWARD LOW like a confident racer gastropod, small sharp mature snail mouth, TWO upper long eyestalks angled forward with small narrow amber eyes under wedge-shaped CHARCOAL protective paper brow caps, TWO lower short feeler tentacles, no eyes on lower face, no animal nose or ears. ONE CHARCOAL NAVY TIRE-SHELL has FIVE large ACID LIME chevron tread blocks along the thick outer band, broad IVORY SPIRAL paper membrane across upper face held by THREE curved warm bamboo ribs anchored at a PURPLE knot hub. The tire is living shell, no steel wheel rim or gears. Exactly TWO BROAD LIME/CHARCOAL sail-like KITE PANELS unfold from opposite side rim hinges, lateral and swept backward like two stabilizing vanes, each made of ONE folded paper surface with ONE long bamboo rib and purple knot, not multiple wings or spikes, no limbs. These are shell's growing wind-catching tread sections. Pose banking slightly to one side with one foot edge pressing ground; clear coherent body remains below and connected to shell opening. ONE purple braided soul cord connected to rear shell/hub knot with TWO complete lime/ivory long tapered paper pennants trailing behind. No detached parts or extra wheels, no shell that looks like a vehicle body. Family means tire traction plus gastropod foot plus functional living kite, not a normal snail carrying a realistic tire. Low agile silhouette contrasts upright towering adult sentinel; this stage learns to catch wind and control lean before adult rises into a giant wheel-vela. Clean confident original 2D MANGA ink, flat gold/ivory/charcoal/navy/acid lime/purple palette, ONE FLAT BASE and ONE hard cel shadow per material. No rubber gloss, gradients, slime realism, tiny tread pattern, crumpled folds, engines, exhaust, speed lines, text, logos, scenery or effects. Full complete creature, both side vanes, four tentacles, tire and soul tail in generous white margins.
story: Inclina a concha e abre duas membranas para captar vento; aprende a orientar o corpo antes de rolar.
review: Concha única quase horizontal, duas grandes abas ligadas por nós e varetas, um pé largo, quatro tentáculos. Rabiola completa com dois terminais. Postura mostra orientação do casco, não comprova rotação ou voo. Sem peças mecânicas.

name: Adulto — Espirrodante (nome proposto)
prompt: Create ONE ORIGINAL ADULT Soulmonsters based on a LAND SNAIL plus CAR TIRE, a living KITE creature, not robot or vehicle. Supplied own knight reference ONLY specifies clean flat 2D MANGA hard cel finish, not knight anatomy, strings, face or palette. Full complete three-quarter creature on WHITE with generous margins. Imposing unusual mature GASTROPOD WIND-WHEEL creature: ONE SINGLE enormous VERTICAL annular CHARCOAL NAVY TIRE-SHELL with SIX very large simple CHEVRON TREAD BLOCKS around outer circumference, no micro tread or letters or realistic rubber texture. Tire shell is the creature's coiled home: visible near side has a broad IVORY SPIRAL tensioned PAPER membrane with THREE curved honey bamboo ribs radiating from one PURPLE soul knot hub; restrained ACID LIME edge stripes and four large dark/lime folding tread flaps project outward like WIND-CATCHING KITE PANELS, not spikes or blades. NO metal car wheel, engine, exhaust, spokes made of steel, headlights or gears. The mature GOLDEN OCHRE soft-bodied SNAIL itself has reorganized into a strong upright U-CURVED muscular neck that threads through the OPEN FRONT HALF of the tire shell, anatomically connected at lower central mantle. Head extends forward and upward from wheel center, small compared with enormous shell; two long upper EYESTALKS with narrow AMBER IRIS eyes at their tips, each eye under an angular dark navy protective paper brow cap, looking alert and assured. Exactly TWO additional SHORT lower feeler tentacles, no eyes on face beneath eye stalks, one confident small mouth seam on lower head. Ochre body and creamy ivory underside, broad clean facets of stretched paper muscle, NOT realistic slime or skin. Its ONE MUSCULAR FOOT broadens into a wide FORWARD-SWEEPING ivory/gold FOLDED PAPER SKID like an icebreaker prow beneath head, three broad ribbed underside folds, clear organic connection to body; foot reaches floor in front of the tire to steer and brake. No separate arms or legs. ONE short rear mantle tapers into ONE PURPLE braided SOUL CORD from HUB attachment with TWO lime/ivory tapered kite pennants flowing out behind, full complete cord visible. This is the same snail whose tire shell has become a tensioned wind-wheel; living tissue, foot and shell integrated, not a normal snail sitting atop a loose tire or a motorcycle. Mature sentinel presence, small narrow eyes, substantial body, no cute cartoon mascot face. Functional identity: tire tread for traction, open kite flaps for wind, foot for steering/support. Wheel dominates vertical silhouette with head emerging above forward opening, clean negative spaces, varied geometry, no conventional biped knight. Palette golden ochre/orange shadow body, warm ivory paper, charcoal/navy tire, acid lime accents, deep purple soul knots and warm bamboo. ONE FLAT BASE and ONE HARD CEL SHADOW per material, crisp dark original 2D MANGA ink with selective stepped edges; no glossy rubber, gradients, realistic reflections, scratches, busy paper crumpling, glow, text, logos, scenery or companion creatures. All tentacles, tread flaps, skid foot, full tire and rabiola within margins.
story: Amplia o casco em roda-vela vertical; combina apoio do pé e painéis de vento para controlar deslocamento e defesa.
review: Uma concha-pneu vertical com quatro abas, um pé amplo e quatro tentáculos. Olhos nos dois tentáculos superiores; nenhum olho extra na face. Rabiola ligada à área posterior com dois terminais. O corpo aparece à frente do casco, não atravessando seu centro como imaginado no brief; revisão de movimento necessária antes de animar. Não certificar rotação por esta pose.
